2609.09056.title: Time-Varying Data as Sheaves: an Invitation to Narratives
2609.09056.paper_summary: Modern science and engineering increasingly rely on time-varying data, yet the mathematical tools used to model temporal phenomena are often developed within separate disciplines, obscuring common principles and limiting the transfer of ideas across fields. This chapter presents the theory of narratives, an abstract framework for time-varying objects of any mathematical kind that supports both theoretical investigations and applications. To illustrate this perspective, the chapter develops three vignettes, each illustrating a different research direction. The first addresses a general concern: What information loss can occur when switching between different representations of temporal data? The second concerns structural and algorithmic approaches: How can we systematically decompose time-varying data into simple pieces and obtain invariants describing its structural complexity? The third is an application to control theory: How can we model multi-agent systems with switching communication topologies? More important than any individual vignette, the central message of this invitation is that a suitable abstract perspective can organize and guide research across remarkably diverse mathematical and scientific domains.
2609.09056.paper_summary_zh: 現代科學和工程越來越依賴於隨時間變化的數據，然而用於建模時間現象的數學工具往往是在不同學科中發展的，這使得共同原則變得模糊，並限制了跨領域的思想轉移。<lb/>本章介紹了敘事理論，這是一個適用於任何數學類型的隨時間變化對象的抽象框架，支持理論研究和應用。<lb/>為了說明這一觀點，本章發展了三個小插曲，每個插曲展示了不同的研究方向。<lb/>第一個插曲涉及一個普遍的問題：在不同的時間數據表示之間切換時，可能會發生什麼信息損失？<lb/>第二個插曲關注結構和算法方法：我們如何系統地將隨時間變化的數據分解為簡單的部分，並獲得描述其結構複雜性的不變量？<lb/>第三個插曲是對控制理論的應用：我們如何建模具有切換通信拓撲的多智能體系統？<lb/>比起任何單一的小插曲，更重要的是這個邀請的核心信息是，適當的抽象視角可以組織和指導在極其多樣的數學和科學領域中的研究。
